label: bubble_valid
definition: Sharp measurable bubble; include in bubble-size validation.

label: bubble_blurred_ignore
definition: Likely bubble but too blurred for reliable sizing.

label: nonbubble_artifact
definition: Cloud, stain, dirt, optical shadow, or false texture.

label: bubble_border_partial
definition: Bubble touches image or field-of-view border.

label: saturated_highlight
definition: Bright glare/highlight region that should be flagged.

label: particle
definition: Solid particle; not a bubble and not included in bubble-size histogram.

label: bubble_particle_overlap_review
definition: Bubble and particle overlap or touch; requires review.
